# Paula's Hair & Beauty Salon

> Unisex hair and beauty salon on Birmingham High Street (B23 6SD), led by stylists Paula Esteves and Dulce Zolana. Specialises in weaves, wigs, braids, twists, and bridal glam for all hair textures. Open Tuesday–Saturday, 10am–6pm.

Paula's Hair & Beauty Salon is a real, independently-run salon, not a franchise or directory listing. Booking and contact enquiries are handled directly through this website.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://paulashairandbeautysalon.com/): overview, hours, and quick links to booking
- [Services & Prices](https://paulashairandbeautysalon.com/services.html): full price list for weaves, wigs, braids, everyday hair, and bridal/glam services
- [Wig Gallery](https://paulashairandbeautysalon.com/wigs.html): photos of past wig installs
- [About](https://paulashairandbeautysalon.com/about.html): the two lead stylists, Paula and Dulce
- [Book an appointment](https://paulashairandbeautysalon.com/booking.html): online booking form
- [Contact](https://paulashairandbeautysalon.com/contact.html): phone, email, WhatsApp, and a contact form
- [FAQ](https://paulashairandbeautysalon.com/faq.html): common questions about services and hours
- [Privacy policy](https://paulashairandbeautysalon.com/privacy.html): what happens to information submitted through the site's forms
